title: Quarterly volunteer report
body: Volunteers logged 1,240 hours this quarter. Contact the coordinator at maria.lopez@example.org for the full schedule. Attendance rose in all three community centres.

title: Library opening hours
body: The main library opens at 9:00 and closes at 20:00 on weekdays. Weekend hours are 10:00 to 16:00. The reading room is closed on public holidays.

title: Park cleanup sign-up
body: Join the park cleanup on Saturday morning. Questions can go to j.chen@example.net or to the front desk. Gloves and bags are provided.

title: Community garden rules
body: Each plot holder waters their own plot. Shared tools are returned to the shed by 19:00. Report broken tools to garden.team@example.com.
